# The paths the site is built from. A pull request that changes none of them
# gets no preview, and runs the browser suites only if it changes one of
# browser-test-paths.txt. Read by scripts/pr-changes.mjs.
#
# One path per line: `dir/` is everything under dir, anything else is that one
# file. Every path must exist (scripts/pr-changes.test.mjs checks it).
src/
public/
scripts/
docs/
astro.config.mjs
tsconfig.json
package.json
package-lock.json
